questions.question: What is a “target customer” in visual merchandising?
questions.solution_html:
• A target customer is the specific group of customers a store wants to attract and sell
  • products to. They are identified based on age, gender, income, lifestyle, and buying
  • behaviour. Visual merchandisers design store displays, colours, lighting, and themes
  • according to the preferences of the target customers. For example, a youth fashion store uses
  • trendy colours and modern displays to attract young buyers. Understanding target customers
  • helps improve sales and customer satisfaction.
questions.final_answer: helps improve sales and customer satisfaction

questions.question: How does visual merchandising increase sales and improve store / image?
questions.solution_html:
• Visual merchandising attracts customers through attractive displays, lighting, colours, and
  • store arrangements. It improves product visibility and encourages impulse buying. Proper
  • visual merchandising creates a pleasant shopping atmosphere and helps customers understand
  • product features. It also strengthens brand identity and improves the store image. Attractive
  • window displays and organized interiors encourage customers to enter the store and make
  • purchases.

questions.question: What role do window displays play in shaping a store’s image?
questions.solution_html:
• Window displays are the first point of communication between the store and customers.
  • They attract attention and create curiosity about the products inside. Effective window
  • displays communicate the brand image, seasonal themes, and fashion trends. They help
  • convert passers-by into customers. Attractive displays also create a strong visual identity and
  • improve the store’s reputation.

questions.question: Describe the different types of store layouts used in retail stores.
questions.solution_html:
• Grid Layout
  • Straight aisles arranged in rows, commonly used in supermarkets.
  • Racetrack Layout
  • Circular pathway guiding customers through the entire store.
  • Free-flow Layout
  • Flexible arrangement allowing creative product placement, common in fashion stores.
  • Boutique Layout
  • Small sections arranged for different product categories, creating an exclusive shopping
  • experience.
  • Proper store layout improves customer movement and product visibility.
questions.final_answer: Proper store layout improves customer movement and product visibility

questions.question: Explain how merchandising planning supports seasonal themes and / promotional layouts.
questions.solution_html:
• Merchandising planning ensures that the right products are available during seasonal events
  • and promotions. It helps visual merchandisers arrange products according to themes such as
  • Christmas, Valentine’s Day, or festival sales. Proper planning supports attractive displays
  • avoids stock shortages, and improves coordination between buyers and visual merchandisers.
  • This increases customer interest and sales.
questions.final_answer: This increases customer interest and sales

questions.question: Why is availability of merchandise important for visual displays?
questions.solution_html:

  • products are in stock. Customers may lose interest if displayed items are unavailable. Proper
  • stock availability supports seasonal displays, promotional themes, and customer satisfaction.
  • It also helps maintain the store image and increases sales opportunities.

questions.question: Discuss in detail the importance of mannequins in retail stores, / including their role as silent salespersons, group display usage, and the need for periodic change.
questions.solution_html:
• silent salespersons, group display usage, and the need for periodic change.

  • display garments attractively and communicate fashion trends to customers.

  • Mannequins are called silent salespersons because they promote products without speaking.
  • They show customers how garments fit and appear when worn. Customers can easily

  • jewellery along with garments.

  • Mannequins and clothing displays should be changed regularly to avoid monotony and
  • maintain customer interest. Seasonal and promotional updates keep the store fresh and
  • attractive.
